verdict.rationale: Riveter runs scraping and extraction as a managed, hosted service. You call it via API or SDK, configure jobs with natural-language prompts or structured specs, and can schedule projects to refresh, so no infrastructure management is needed. However, there is no evidence that developers can write and deploy their own custom scraping code or functions on the platform; customization is limited to prompt- and spec-driven configuration. Missing for 10: deploying user-authored scraping scripts or serverless functions, a code runtime or deployment workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
